findings.detail: F26 compares differently scoped leverage views and reports a 28.05-point divergence even though source-derived debt/net-assets and debt-investment-share differ by only 7.75 points.

rationale: Raw filing values show fund debt of 2,403,410 (credit facilities 957,521 plus debt securitization 406,440 plus notes 1,039,449) against net assets of 2,934,192, or 81.91%. The investment schedule shows senior and subordinated debt fair value of 4,623,222 against total portfolio fair value of 5,156,571, or 89.66%. These independently disclosed views differ by 7.75 percentage points, below F26's 20-point threshold, while the flag reports 28.05 points. The underlying source data are coherent; the failure arises from the check's anchor or scope construction.
